response: Visceral adipose tissue (VAT) area measurement at a single level, specifically 3 cm above the lower margin of the L3 vertebra, can indeed represent visceral adipose tissue volume. This measurement is feasible and can reflect changes in VAT volume and body weight. In fact, VAT area at this specific location is considered the best reflection of interval changes in VAT volume and body weight. Therefore, when measuring visceral adipose tissue area, it is recommended to select this location for the most accurate representation of VAT volume.
